lines: Hey. There's something I've been meaning to say.
I've noticed you've been getting close to someone else.
I'm not asking you to pick sides. But I'd rather hear it from you than sit here guessing.

choices.text: You're right. I should have talked to you.
Can we talk about this another time?

lines: You don't need to have every answer right now. Just be straight with me.
But if we're close, don't act like it means nothing to me.
Just don't leave it hanging forever.
